description: This file defines the CompressionCodec trait and multiple implementations for different compression algorithms used in Apache Spark, including LZ4, LZF, Snappy, ZStd, and support functions for creating and managing codecs.

classes.name: CompressionCodec
classes.description: Trait defining the interface for compression codecs, including methods for obtaining compressed input and output streams.

classes.name: LZ4CompressionCodec
classes.description: Implementation of CompressionCodec for LZ4 compression, with configurable block size.

classes.name: LZFCompressionCodec
classes.description: Implementation of CompressionCodec for LZF compression, supporting parallel and non-parallel modes.

classes.name: SnappyCompressionCodec
classes.description: Implementation of CompressionCodec for Snappy compression, with configurable block size.

classes.name: ZStdCompressionCodec
classes.description: Implementation of CompressionCodec for ZStd compression, with configurable buffer size, level, strategy, and support for continuous streams.

methods.name: supportsConcatenationOfSerializedStreams
methods.description: Checks if the given codec supports concatenation of serialized streams.

methods.name: getCodecName
methods.description: Retrieves the codec name from SparkConf.

methods.name: createCodec
methods.description: Creates a CompressionCodec instance based on SparkConf and codec name.

methods.name: getShortName
methods.description: Returns the short name for a given codec name.
